info.name: Booking Microservices (Day 45)
info.description:
Local API collection for the booking learning project.

Import together with Booking-microservices.local.postman_environment.json.
Services: api http://localhost:3000, identity http://localhost:3001.
Prerequisite: `npm run seed:reference --workspace=@booking-flight-system/api` (airports + aircraft; flights need a registered aircraft since Day 46).
Flow: register -> promote-to-admin (CLI) -> login (accessToken, role=admin) -> register + login bob (userAccessToken) -> create flight (SCHEDULED) -> open it -> book as bob.

Progress covered:
- Day 9–15: flights CRUD, auth, audit, migrations
- Day 26–29: bookings, cancel, correlationId
- Day 31–34: Identity JWT + role; POST /api/flights requires admin JWT
- Day 35–40: api + identity run on Postgres (booking_db / identity_db); /ready checks Postgres
- Day 44: booking ownership — JWT on every booking route, GET /api/bookings(/:id), BOLA folder
- Day 45: airports + aircraft with seat layouts (reference data folder)
- Day 46: flights reference airports/aircraft; SCHEDULED → OPEN lifecycle; SALES_CLOSED
- Day 47: per-flight seat inventory, derived availableSeats, public seat map, booking shows its seat

Run top to bottom on a database without VN461/VN462 on 2026-11-20; a second run answers 409 FLIGHT_ALREADY_EXISTS on the creates.
Statuses: SCHEDULED/OPEN/CANCELLED are stored; CLOSED (1 h before departure) and DEPARTED are derived from the clock on every read (ADR-008).

item.name: POST /api/flights (same aircraft, departs 30 min after landing → 409)

request.description: BR-FLT-03/08: the aircraft is busy until arrival + 45 min. Decided by the EXCL_flights_aircraft_schedule exclusion constraint, so two admins racing cannot both win.
The occupancy window is half-open, [departure, arrival + 45 min): the boundary itself is free. This flight is left SCHEDULED for the SALES_CLOSED request below.
Capacity is no longer client-set. Rejected loudly (UNSUPPORTED_FIELD) instead of silently ignored, so an old client notices the breaking change.

BR-FLT-05. details[0].code says why: NOT_ALLOWED here, DEPARTURE_TOO_SOON for a flight 1 hour or less from departure. A lost concurrent open answers 409 FLIGHT_STATUS_CHANGED instead.

item.name: Day 47 — Seat inventory

Each flight owns its seats (copied from the aircraft on create); availableSeats is counted from them on every read; booking claims the lowest free seat (FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED), cancelling releases it.

Day 48B — Hold expiry (2 of 2: after the deadline)

Run after folder 1 and the psql command it prints, with bob's userAccessToken and carol's userBAccessToken. Finds bob's hold as his newest booking, so it also runs on its own (newman --folder).

item.name: Day 49B — Payment
item.description:
Needs the dev seed (VN-B210, economy only), alice's accessToken (admin), bob's userAccessToken and carol's userBAccessToken.
Run top to bottom on a database without VN493 on 2026-12-08. Each run draws a new Idempotency-Key prefix (day49bKey).
Payment runs in three phases around the simulated gateway (ADR-009): tok_success is charged, tok_decline declined. A final answer is stored with the key and replayed byte for byte with Idempotent-Replayed: true. To watch the race with expiry by hand, start the app with PAYMENT_SIMULATOR_DELAY_MS=8000 and back-date hold_expires_at with psql while a payment runs (README, Day 49B).

item.name: Day 49C — Payment failures
item.description:
Needs the dev seed (VN-B210, economy only), alice's accessToken (admin) and bob's userAccessToken, and the app's reconciliation job running (docker compose app or npm run dev).
Run top to bottom on a database without VN496 on 2026-12-11. Each run draws a new Idempotency-Key prefix (day49cKey).
tok_lost_response makes the simulated provider take the money and lose its answer: the request waits for the gateway timeout (PAYMENT_GATEWAY_TIMEOUT_MS, default 10 s) and answers 202 PROCESSING, never FAILED (BR-PAY-08). The key stays in progress until the reconciliation job charges the same payment id again (30 s after the timeout, job every 30 s); then the same key gets the final 201, replayed. Request 7 waits 75 s before sending.

item.name: Identity (Day 31–34)

New users are role=user; promote with:

then log in again to get a token with role=admin.
